instruction: Write an XDP program that drops IPv4 TCP packets with invalid or abnormal flag combination #7 (e.g. SYN and FIN both set) and passes all other packets.
requirements: Drop IPv4 TCP packets having SYN (0x02) and FIN (0x01) flags set simultaneously
Pass all valid TCP packets and non-TCP packets
Handle variable IP header length and verify boundaries

tests.name: test_syn_fin_drop
tests.description: TCP packet with SYN+FIN flags set should be dropped

tests.name: test_syn_pass
tests.description: TCP packet with SYN flag only should pass

tests.name: test_ack_pass
tests.description: TCP packet with ACK flag should pass
